title: Verification pass 2026-10-28: six figures published, the Medicare Bridge confirmed, every Lilly property still unread
summary: The second primary-source verification pass. trumprx.gov, medicare.gov, novocare.com, ozempic.com, aspe.hhs.gov, fda.gov, cms.gov and investor.lilly.com were all read directly on 2026-10-28, and the figures below were confirmed with their conditions. Six figures that previously rendered no price now do: the Wegovy injection standard-dose TrumpRx price, the Foundayo TrumpRx price, and the Medicare GLP-1 Bridge copayment for four medications. Every Eli Lilly property refused an automated read with HTTP 403, so the LillyDirect, LillyCares and Lilly pricing figures remain unverified and still render no price; they are listed for a browser read in OWNER_STEPS.md. Two of the five pending eligibility rules were retired against verbatim quotes read on medicare.gov.
changes: Wegovy injection, standard doses, TrumpRx: no published figure to $349 per month for the 1 mg, 1.7 mg and 2.4 mg strengths. Read 2026-10-28 at https://trumprx.gov/p/wegovy, which states that this price applies from the first fill and is not a figure that follows a promotional period.

Foundayo, TrumpRx: no published figure to $149 per month for the 0.8 mg and 2.5 mg tablets, one bottle of 30 tablets. Read 2026-10-28 at https://trumprx.gov/p/foundayo, which states one hundred ninety nine dollars for the 5.5 mg strength and two hundred ninety nine dollars for the 9 mg, 14.5 mg and 17.2 mg strengths.
Zepbound, Medicare GLP-1 Bridge: no published figure to $50 per month for a monthly supply, the copayment a beneficiary pays. Read 2026-10-28 at https://www.medicare.gov/coverage/weight-loss-drugs.
Wegovy injection, Medicare GLP-1 Bridge: no published figure to $50 per month for a monthly supply. Read 2026-10-28 at https://www.medicare.gov/coverage/weight-loss-drugs.
Wegovy tablets, Medicare GLP-1 Bridge: no published figure to $50 per month for a monthly supply. Read 2026-10-28 at https://www.medicare.gov/coverage/weight-loss-drugs.
Foundayo, Medicare GLP-1 Bridge: no published figure to $50 per month for a monthly supply. Read 2026-10-28 at https://www.medicare.gov/coverage/weight-loss-drugs.

Ozempic, TrumpRx: $199 to $199, re-verified 2026-10-28 at https://trumprx.gov/p/ozempic. The introductory terms are now read from the platform rather than reported: new self-pay patients pay this figure for the first two monthly fills of the 0.25 mg or 0.5 mg strengths, and the offer runs only between 11/17/2025 and 12/31/2026.

Zepbound, TrumpRx: $299 to $299, re-verified 2026-10-28 at https://trumprx.gov/p/zepbound. The per-strength prices are now read from the platform: $399 for the 5 mg vial and $449 for the 7.5 mg, 10 mg, 12.5 mg and 15 mg vials.
Wegovy injection, starting doses, TrumpRx: $199 to $199, re-verified 2026-10-28 at https://trumprx.gov/p/wegovy, with the introductory terms now read from the platform.
Ozempic, NovoCare self-pay: $199 to $199, re-verified 2026-10-28 at https://www.novocare.com/pharmacy.html, with the introductory terms now quoted from the manufacturer page.
Wegovy injection, starting doses, NovoCare self-pay: $199 to $199, re-verified 2026-10-28 at https://www.novocare.com/pharmacy.html, with the introductory terms now quoted from the manufacturer page.
Wegovy injection, standard doses, NovoCare self-pay: $349 to $349, re-verified 2026-10-28 at https://www.novocare.com/pharmacy.html. The Wegovy HD 7.2 mg figure is now exact at $399 per month.

Wegovy tablets, 1.5 mg, NovoCare self-pay: $149 to $149, re-verified 2026-10-28 at https://www.novocare.com/pharmacy.html. The per-strength figures are now exact: $199 for 4 mg and $299 for 9 mg and 25 mg.
Wegovy tablets, higher doses, NovoCare self-pay: $199 to $199, re-verified 2026-10-28 at https://www.novocare.com/pharmacy.html. The 9 mg and 25 mg figures are now exact at $299 per month.

Ozempic, NovoCare savings card: no published figure to no published figure, re-checked 2026-10-28 at https://www.ozempic.com/savings-and-resources/save-on-ozempic.html. The manufacturer states the offer as a bound, "Pay as little as $25, subject to a maximum savings of $100/month", and a bound is not a price.

Wegovy injection, NovoCare savings card: no published figure to no published figure, re-checked 2026-10-28 at https://www.novocare.com/pharmacy.html, which states the same bound and excludes government beneficiaries.

Ozempic, list price: no published figure to no published figure, still conflicting. Re-checked 2026-10-28: the manufacturer page states no list price, and the federal platform shows an unlabelled reference price, which does not resolve the two circulating figures.

Zepbound, list price: no published figure to no published figure, still conflicting. Re-checked 2026-10-28 at https://trumprx.gov/p/zepbound, which shows an unlabelled reference price that does not resolve the circulating manufacturer figures.

Wegovy injection, list price: no published figure to no published figure. Re-checked 2026-10-28 at https://www.novocare.com/pharmacy.html and https://trumprx.gov/p/wegovy; neither states a list price.
Wegovy tablets, list price: no published figure to no published figure. Re-checked 2026-10-28; no list price is stated for the oral product.

Medicare Part D, all six medications: no published figure to no published figure. The Part D page was read on 2026-10-28 and publishes no price for these medicines, because what a beneficiary pays depends on their own plan.
Eligibility rule, Medicare GLP-1 Bridge requires Medicare: pending primary verification to a verbatim quote from medicare.gov, read 2026-10-28.
Eligibility rule, Medicare GLP-1 Bridge Part D exclusion: pending primary verification to a verbatim quote from medicare.gov, read 2026-10-28.
Eligibility rule, Medicare GLP-1 Bridge clinical criteria: the clinical criteria and the covered formulations are now quoted from medicare.gov rather than described as reported and unconfirmed.
Eligibility rule, TrumpRx manual curation: trumprx.gov is now readable, so the figures on that pathway are read from the platform rather than curated by hand.

Correction, Zepbound, TrumpRx: the introductory-pricing caveat previously carried on this pathway was removed. The direct read of https://trumprx.gov/p/zepbound on 2026-10-28 shows no introductory period and no fill limit for Zepbound, and a per-strength tier structure with a 45-day refill condition instead. The card now states those conditions and the per-strength prices.

Attempted and refused, 2026-10-28: lillydirect.lilly.com, zepbound.lilly.com, mounjaro.lilly.com, pricinginfo.lilly.com, www.lilly.com and www.lillycares.com all returned HTTP 403 with a bot-protection interstitial. Every Lilly-sourced figure stays unverified with the attempt recorded against it.

Recorded, not promoted, 2026-10-28: the federal poverty guidelines for 2026 were read directly at https://aspe.hhs.gov/topics/poverty-economic-mobility/poverty-guidelines, so the denominator for any income threshold is now held, but the programme threshold itself remains unread and the rule stays pending.

Not read in this pass, 2026-10-28: novonordiskpap.com, which the patient-assistance rows for Ozempic and Wegovy cite, is outside the egress allowlist in docs/ops-runbook.md and was not probed; the BALANCE Model participating-state list could not be located by a static fetch of cms.gov or innovation.cms.gov.

title: First verified prices: NovoCare Pharmacy and TrumpRx read directly
summary: The first primary-source reads since launch. The NovoCare Pharmacy page and the federal TrumpRx platform were read directly on September 28, 2026, and eight figures were confirmed with their conditions; two insured offers were confirmed as bounds (which are not prices, so they still render no number). Every Lilly-sourced figure remains unverified because Lilly properties refuse automated readers.
changes: Confirmed on NovoCare Pharmacy: Wegovy pill self-pay tiers (starting strength, the 4 mg strength, and the two highest strengths at a higher verified figure), Wegovy injection introductory price for the two starting doses (first two monthly fills, offer verified through December 31, 2026) with the ongoing prices for standard and HD strengths, and the Ozempic introductory price with its verified ongoing prices per strength.

Confirmed on TrumpRx: the Zepbound, Ozempic and Wegovy pen monthly figures as displayed on the federal platform, each beside the reference figure the platform shows. The previously conflicting Zepbound figure is superseded by the current listing.
Recorded, not promoted: the insured "pay as little as" offers on NovoCare Pharmacy are verified bounds with a verified monthly savings cap, and bounds never become values under the rules of evidence.
Attempted and refused: every Lilly property refused automated readers (HTTP 403, gateway errors, timeouts), so all Lilly-sourced figures stay unverified with the attempt recorded against each.
The end-date ambiguity on the introductory offers is resolved by the direct read: the verified offer runs through December 31, 2026.

title: Site launch, with no verified prices
summary: The tool, the engine and the full source manifest go live. No price renders as a number, because on this date no figure could be confirmed against a primary source. This entry exists so the gap is on the record from day one rather than discovered later.
changes: Published the ranking engine covering 6 medications and 8 payment pathways, with eligibility rules held as data rather than prose.

Filed all 45 tracked price figures as unverified or conflicting with a null value. Outbound connections to every primary source (fda.gov, cms.gov, medicare.gov, hhs.gov, trumprx.gov, sec.gov, and all Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk domains) were refused by the network this build runs on, so none could be read directly.
Recorded, alongside each unverified figure, what research located and the provenance actually held for it, so a single verification pass can promote it without a code change.
Marked the TrumpRx pathway as manually curated: programmatic access to trumprx.gov is refused, and the November 2025 announced figures conflict with later readings of the live platform.
Excluded compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide entirely, the current lawful status being unestablished against FDA sources.
Suppressed manufacturer savings cards for Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE and VA beneficiaries rather than ranking them lower, so a pathway that cannot be used is not shown as an option.
Applied the reported Medicare Bridge sleep-apnea exclusion despite being unable to confirm it, on the grounds that omitting a real exclusion would quote a price to a beneficiary who cannot obtain it.
